title: Clustering, anomalías y validación temporal
scope: LESSONS_ONLY: title/tagline/job relevance, 8 outcomes, 44/44 theory/reference paragraphs, 9 theory code/output blocks, 9 callouts, 3 figures, plus the S36-specific interactive playground rendered inside Theory. I Do / We Do / You Do / self-check / exams excluded.

roadmap.T1: Clustering: escalamiento y k-means/density; elección, estabilidad y métricas limitadas.
roadmap.T2: Dimensión: PCA y visualización; interpretación prudente de proyecciones.
roadmap.T3: Anomalías: Isolation Forest/LOF y reglas; novelty vs outlier y contamination.
roadmap.T4: Tiempo y evaluación: backtests temporales; etiquetas escasas y utilidad de revisión.
roadmap.gate: Señales no supervisadas que ayudan al triage sin convertir rareza/cluster en conducta indebida y sin leakage temporal.

live_status.public_card_tagline: Señales auxiliares evaluadas por utilidad de revisión; una anomalía nunca es conclusión de conducta indebida.
live_status.reason: The available public crawl is stale; do not promote the hours mismatch to a current deployment defect without a fresh hydrated render.

research_basis.use: KMeans minimizes within-cluster sum-of-squares; cluster geometry and internal metrics have limitations.
eps is neighborhood distance and min_samples includes the point itself.
Mean/std are learned fitted state and reused for transform.
PCA centers but does not automatically scale features; components and explained variance have specific meanings.
Outlier and novelty modes differ; LOF novelty=True prediction/scoring is for new unseen samples.
contamination helps define the outlier threshold/proportion, not intrinsically review capacity.
Time-ordered splits prevent train-on-future; gap may separate train/test.
ARI compares partitions invariant to label permutations.

runtime_counterexamples.impact: empty batch has no controlled contract
zip silently drops two data rows
negative cluster label silently indexes last cluster
invalid density policy marks every point core
nonfinite internal score can become chosen k
one-sided projection check misses a large negative-side outlier
guard permits moralized naming prohibited by prose
default self-reference lets anomaly contaminate baseline
training on future month is not detected
k larger than support silently treats missing ranks as negatives

rejected_findings.evidence: Source counts the sample itself, matching sklearn.

rejected_findings.claim: Fixed-weight PCA toy falsely claims real PCA.
rejected_findings.evidence: Source explicitly says weights are fixed scaffolding, not learned eigenvectors.

rejected_findings.claim: Fixed-cut Isolation Forest toy is presented as real ensemble.
rejected_findings.evidence: Source explicitly calls it a one-path toy.
Prose repeatedly rejects that inference; executable enforcement/evaluation is the defect.

rejected_findings.claim: Scaling before every KMeans/PCA is universally required.
rejected_findings.evidence: Scaling is a modeling choice tied to units/metric; source overstates an otherwise useful warning.

rejected_findings.claim: 19h live versus 9h source is confirmed current deployment defect.

findings.summary: S36 assumes S35 outputs are valid although S35 remains REPAIR_REQUIRED.
findings.fix: Require machine-valid inherited prediction/policy/explanation/audit artifacts.

findings.summary: Cluster/anomaly/P@k artifacts lack sample, data, feature, scaler, detector, threshold-policy and as-of lineage.
findings.fix: Introduce immutable UnsupervisedSignalManifest and keyed rows.

findings.summary: misconduct_auto=False, verdict=False, human_review=True and similar fields are hard-coded, not validators.
findings.fix: Validate structured claims/actions and routing.

findings.summary: Legacy ai-apis-advanced ID renders an LLM function-calling playground in S36 Theory.
findings.fix: Map the stable ID to an S36 clustering/anomaly playground.

findings.summary: Scaling is framed as universally non-optional instead of a geometry/units choice.
findings.fix: Explain when standardization is appropriate and when deliberate units/weights matter.

findings.summary: K-means is described as repeating until nothing moves, omitting tolerance/max_iter stopping.
findings.fix: State convergence within tolerance or iteration limit.

findings.summary: One-dimensional single-feature toy cannot demonstrate cross-feature magnitude domination.
findings.fix: Use at least two features with different units.

findings.summary: zscore_list crashes empty and certifies NaN/nonfinite values as scaled=True.
findings.fix: Validate non-empty finite inputs before producing fitted state.

findings.summary: Scaling is recomputed from the current batch and not frozen/versioned.
findings.fix: Fit on reference/train and transform later rows with stored state.

findings.summary: update_centroids zip-truncates mismatched rows and accepts invalid/negative labels.
findings.fix: Enforce exact lengths, k and label domains.

findings.summary: density helper accepts invalid eps/min_samples.
findings.fix: Require finite eps>=0 and integer min_samples>=1.

findings.summary: Rolling-origin temporal figure is attached to k-selection T1-B rather than temporal T4-A.
findings.fix: Move figure to T4-A.

findings.summary: Multi-seed k selection uses handwritten score maps rather than seeded clusterings.
findings.fix: Run actual repeated seeded clusterings.

findings.summary: Same selected k is not partition stability.
findings.fix: Measure partition agreement with ARI and/or centroid/assignment sensitivity.

findings.summary: choose_k crashes empty, accepts NaN and has implicit ties.
findings.fix: Validate finite maps and deterministic ties.

findings.summary: Prose says capacity/business sense affects k but code never consumes capacity.
findings.fix: Separate geometric candidate selection from downstream queue constraints.

findings.summary: Numeric cluster labels are not explicitly taught as arbitrary/permutable.
findings.fix: Show label-swap example and prohibit semantics from cluster numbers.

findings.summary: silhouette/ARI are underexplained.
findings.fix: Define them intuitively before use and state limitations.

findings.summary: scale_xy crashes empty, propagates nonfinite state and lacks reusable fitted scaler.
findings.fix: Separate fit/transform and validate inputs.

findings.summary: weight_share_pc1 is coefficient absolute mass, not explained variance/importance; zero vector returns meaningful-looking 0.
findings.fix: Rename metric and reject zero-mass vector.

findings.summary: far_from_mean sees only positive-side extremes and NaN can false-green.
findings.fix: Use validated absolute deviation or declared distance.

findings.summary: Two-token blacklist permits moralized names such as riesgo_moral/sospechoso.
findings.fix: Use structured allowed naming rather than blacklist.

findings.summary: Exploratory PCA distance directly enqueues review outside frozen policy/capacity/evidence controls.
findings.fix: Route through governed decision policy.

findings.summary: IF/LOF contamination is conflated with review capacity.
findings.fix: Separate estimator contamination/threshold semantics from queue budget policy.

findings.summary: sigma rule misses lower-tail anomalies.
findings.fix: Declare upper-tail business rule or implement two-sided deviation.

findings.summary: ref defaults to xs despite requiring clean/past reference.
findings.fix: Require frozen explicit reference.

findings.summary: sd=0→1 makes 3-sigma threshold arbitrary for constant reference.
findings.fix: Handle constant reference explicitly with tolerance/data-quality policy.

findings.summary: NaN/nonfinite values and invalid thresholds/references are not rejected.
findings.fix: Validate finite inputs and positive finite z.

findings.summary: LOF novelty=True unseen-only prediction rule is omitted.
findings.fix: Teach sklearn novelty/outlier API distinction.

findings.summary: expected_flags accepts invalid contamination and population values.
findings.fix: Validate domain and distinguish detector from queue policy.

findings.summary: int(n*contamination) is treated as exact detector flags and conflates estimator setting with policy.
findings.fix: Use it only as explicit queue-budget arithmetic, not estimator output.

findings.summary: has_leakage only checks duplicate month and misses future training periods.
findings.fix: Parse timestamps and require train times strictly before test, with gap/availability rules.

findings.summary: Backtest lacks keyed event/availability times and reference snapshot.
findings.fix: Use time-aware keyed rows and frozen reference manifest.

findings.summary: backtest=True is literal and window flag rates are handwritten.
findings.fix: Derive and validate backtest from scored rows.

findings.summary: mean_flag_rate crashes empty and accepts invalid rates without support.
findings.fix: Validate 0<=rate<=1 and retain counts per window.

findings.summary: Review-click utility is said to suffice without acknowledging selective feedback.
findings.fix: Track coverage/sampling and distinguish operational feedback from unbiased evaluation.

findings.summary: P@k consumes a pre-ranked utility-label list, so ranking/ties cannot be audited.
findings.fix: Rank keyed scores under stable tie policy.

findings.summary: k>n and nonbinary labels produce distorted/impossible precision.
findings.fix: Require 1<=k<=n and validated binary utility labels.

findings.summary: human_in_loop=True is literal and scarcity/coverage is not derived.
findings.fix: Require reviewer routing/capacity and actual count evidence.

findings.summary: Labels concentrated among reviewed top-ranked cases can reinforce the ranking policy.
findings.fix: Track sampling/coverage and include random/blinded audit samples where needed.

findings.summary: P@k + human feedback is framed as categorically superior to ROC evaluation.
findings.fix: Make P@k the lab queue metric while explaining metric choice depends on objective/coverage.

findings.summary: S36 gates remain prints/literals despite systematic pytest requirement since S27.
findings.fix: Add collected regression tests for all critical contracts.

findings.summary: AML, LOF, ARI, silhouette, path length and English process terms lack consistent Spanish-first definitions.
findings.fix: Expand on first use and reuse compact terms thereafter.
